dsv41-segmented.scope:
Real CUDA full/segmented banks plus DSV sparse RemoteHub RPC on RTX4060.

Native full/breakable backends, QKV/state methods and sparse reader are source-loaded.
Linear/norm/store kernels and the 3-layer model/metadata/indexer/carry planning
boundaries are small fixtures. No DSV checkpoint, SM100, SMG, NCCL or perf claim.

dsv-p-host-staging-native-index.scope: real CUDA+Mooncake TCP, two endpoints on one GPU; toy pool, source-loaded native planners; no DSV4.1 model, full scheduler, NCCL or performance claim

dsv-receive-explicit.scope:
Real DSV4.1 byte plans, CUDA H2D/scatter and Mooncake TCP on one GPU.

Small pools/control sockets are fixtures; native ring, watermark, event lifetime
and data transport are real. No model/server/NCCL or latency claim.

reader-lifetime.scope:
4060: actual GPU reader fence, native Mooncake payloads and cache/slot lifetime.

Tiny native byte pools and cache lock boundary; no full model or RDMA hardware.

prefill-overlap.cache_backend: lock/checkpoint boundary fixture; real hybrid receipt tests on CPU
limitations: No DSV4.1 model load or token accuracy/performance measurement
IO callback fixture; no Mooncake TE or SMG

dsv-p-host-staging.scope: real CUDA+Mooncake TCP, two endpoints on one GPU; toy pool, source-loaded native planners; no DSV4.1 model, full scheduler, NCCL or performance claim

qwen-reservation.scope: Real native paged allocator kernels and PD preallocation on small Qwen pools.

staging-scatter-lifecycle.scope:
Exercise failed deferred-scatter publication with real CUDA copies.

Uses the production DecodeStagingHandler lifecycle loaded from source. The
scatter body is a tiny pinned-host H2D copy; allocator, event-record failures,
and stream-drain failures are explicit fixtures. No model, network, or RDMA
completion semantics are simulated as real hardware validation.

dsv-d2d-local.scope: Group-layer CUDA probes; real transport/kernels, explicit scheduler ABI fixtures.

qwen-d2d-range.scope: Real Qwen layer-group x token-range transport; no model-weight claim.

dsv-d-receive-staging.scope:
Real DSV4.1 byte plans, CUDA H2D/scatter and Mooncake TCP on one GPU.

Small pools/control sockets are fixtures; native ring, watermark, event lifetime
and data transport are real. No model/server/NCCL or latency claim.

rdma-staging.scope:
Real CUDA staging/streams with an explicit in-process fake RDMA NIC boundary.

This does NOT test an RDMA HCA, GPUDirect visibility, or network performance.
The fake NIC uses cudaMemcpyAsync on its own stream and reports completion only
after its event. Native TCP regression is exercised by range_layer_cuda_probe.

qo.scope:
Qwen/DSV Q/O/LSE on real CUDA with native TCP or an explicit fake NIC.

No checkpoint is loaded. Qwen uses FlashInfer; DSV uses native byte layouts and
sparse kernels. Fake NIC/visibility cases do not validate a real RDMA HCA/CQ.

qwen-split.scope:
CUDA split/full equivalence through native Qwen loops and residual boundaries.

Uses the production Qwen3 full/split/decoder methods, split helper, controller
publication, StageBoundary/ResidualStream and RMSNorm; tiny CUDA linear attention
and MLP stand in for model weights/attention and TP layout is single-rank. This
is a lifecycle/continuation probe, not Qwen3-8B inference or a TP accuracy run.
